execution.calibration: validation-only direct validation selection among raw, Platt, isotonic; lowest validation log loss wins

o13_contract.new_information: training-anchored chronological time interaction x_j*t for every frozen O0 feature

interpretation.primary_finding: O13 improves discrimination and classification accuracy on the untouched baseline test, but worsens log loss and Brier. The independent future holdout worsens materially on all reported probability-quality/discrimination metrics.
interpretation.raw_vs_calibrated_note: The temporal interaction does not establish robust calibrated probability quality under temporal shift; validation-selected isotonic calibration does not rescue the future holdout.
interpretation.robustness_note: The primary untouched-test gate already fails on log loss and Brier, so no post-hoc robustness search or tuning was used to rescue O13. The exact historical rolling-origin runner was not altered or inferred for this decision.
interpretation.decision: reject O13 and keep O0 frozen

rules_followed: calibration was selected using validation only
test and future holdout were not used for tuning
no O13 hyperparameter search was performed
